# Croom Baptisms — Page 122 (Mar–Sep 1879)

**Image:** `page_122_baptism_mar_sep1879.jpg`
**Date range (per gon.pages_metadata):** Mar 1879 to Sep 1879
**Officiant on all entries:** Joannes Quinlan (CC, sometimes signed "Dunlan" by transcribers — same priest)

## Patrick Gleeson + Margaret Moloney baptisms

**None found on this page.** Last documented child Jane was baptized 28 Sep 1878 (page 121). No Gleeson/Moloney child appears Mar–Sep 1879.

## Gleeson surname appearances (sponsors only)

| Entry date | Role | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 29 Apr 1879 | Sponsor (godmother) at baptism of Johanna, filia Jacobi Molony et Henricae [?]; co-sponsor Gulielmo Quaid | **Catherinae Gleeson** — same person as our hypothesized Patrick's sister Catherine Gleeson (later Catherine + Daniel Greany) |
| 17 Aug 1879 | Sponsor (godmother) at baptism of Michael, filius Patritii Lynch et Ellena Molony; co-sponsor Jacobi Molony | **Mariae Gleeson** — new name. Could be Patrick's sister, or an in-law of the Croom Gleeson cluster |
| 18 Sep 1879 | Sponsor (godfather) at baptism of Johanna, filia Joannis Blake et Mariae [?]; co-sponsor Honorae [?] | **Gulielmo Gleeson** — new name (William Gleeson) in the Croom Gleeson extended-family network |

## Notable Moloney appearances

- 29 Apr 1879: Jacobi Molony + Henricae [?] baptized daughter Johanna (Catherinae Gleeson as godmother — see above)
- 17 Aug 1879: Patritii Lynch + Ellena Molony baptized son Michael (Jacobi Molony as godfather — Mariae Gleeson as godmother)
- The Molony-Lynch-Gleeson tri-family sponsor cluster continues to consolidate
